result.problems: 1) Resume, not restart: the earlier agent's 5minute run (run_5minute.log) had 50 of 81 fit checkpoints; I resumed the missing jobs and ran score / checks. 2) Design fix before resuming: the hgb_cls learner held one nested tau shared by its net and pf decision heads, so those two heads were identical decisions (duplicate ledger rows). online.py now keeps one tau per decision-side reward (chosen on the record's net vs penalised net); the 3 finished 5minute hgb_cls k=1 checkpoints were deleted and re-run before any of them was scored (no ledger row affected). 3) The task named the gate_family comparator file as oof_<tf>.parquet; gate_family writes results/oof_<tf>_<sub>.parquet (one row per sub x model x unit). run_online.stage_score was changed to read those: the sub-family finalist named in gate_family/findings.json when present (minute: context/hgbc and h5_full/scorecard), else every model in the file (5minute: 11 comparator rows, findings.json did not yet exist at scoring time); the h5_full rows carry vocabulary 'outside the frozen shortlist'. 4) finalize.tape_replay was parallelised (joblib, 3 workers) - same per-tape numbers, tape numbers never enter the ledger. 5) A helper run_tail.py ran the cheapest remaining minute jobs on the core freed when gate_family finished; the primary driver later re-ran a few of the same jobs (identical decisions; only the `seconds` field of the pkl differs); every checkpoint / journal loads with consistent sizes and the checks stage confirms stored = recomputed on the 10-job subset. 6) Cadence k applies to the model refit; the running W / L, calibration record and tau record update at every closed outcome (stated in FINDINGS caveats). 7) The half-Kelly rule on 420,000 INR yields 0 lots on most takes (negative Kelly for p_win ~0.16-0.30 at the running W/L) - reported, not tuned. 8) git status shows earlier commits of this study's files by the parent session; per the brief I did not commit. 9) Rule 0 / S49 entries and REPORT.md belong to the parent session; the FINDINGS carry the null result and what would falsify it.
